header: Monitoring OpenSearch Serverless events using Amazon EventBridge
content:
Amazon OpenSearch Service integrates with Amazon EventBridge to notify you of certain
events that aﬀect your domains. Events from AWS services are delivered to EventBridge in near
real time. The same events are also sent to Amazon CloudWatch Events, the predecessor of
Amazon EventBridge. You can write rules to indicate which events are of interest to you, and
what automated actions to take when an event matches a rule. Examples of actions that you can
automatically activate include the following:
• Invoking an AWS Lambda function
• Invoking an Amazon EC2 Run Command
• Relaying the event to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams
• Activating an AWS Step Functions state machine
• Notifying an Amazon SNS topic or an Amazon SQS queue
